StdDlgTextItem.text: Search: type with the remote, or hold the microphone while the search keyboard is open.
Choose: 4K sources appear first, with 1080p below. Press * to switch between all qualities and 4K only.
Play: OK starts the selected source. Pause shows playback details. The source's 4K label is separate from the decoded resolution.
Setup: add a stream source in Add-ons. For 5.1, connect Roku to the AX700 HDMI input and choose DD+ or Dolby Digital audio.
